Configuration reference

The controller reads config.toml at startup. Unknown keys are rejected.

Settings

KeyTypeDefaultDescription
listen_portinteger7070TCP port for the control API
heartbeat_secondsinteger15Interval between widget heartbeats
max_widgetsinteger256Upper bound on registered widgets
log_formatstringjsonEither json or text

Example

listen_port = 7070
heartbeat_seconds = 10
max_widgets = 512
log_format = "json"
